## DNA methylation analysis pipeline

An end-to-end, reproducible R pipeline (built with `targets`) for Illumina 450K, EPIC and EPICv2 methylation arrays. It goes from raw IDATs to QC, copy-number calling, methylation-based classification and differential methylation:

- **Preprocessing and QC:** sesame processing, detection p-value filtering, sex-mismatch and SNP-probe checks.
- **Copy-number alterations:** conumee2 segmentation and summary plots.
- **Classification:** SVM-based methylation classifier.
- **Differential methylation:** DMRcate region calling plus ComplexHeatmap summaries of differentially methylated probes.

[Read the full report on a test dataset](dnam-pipeline-report.qmd) | [Source code](https://github.com/Aggarwal-Ayush/dna-methylation-analysis)

## MelDat

An R Shiny application for exploring melanocyte-related (bulk and single-cell) datasets, including your own RNA-seq or microarray data. [Launch MelDat](https://ayushagg.shinyapps.io/MelDat/).
